text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. High quality hand-drawn 2D cel-animation environment background, coastal magic academy rooftop astronomy classroom, brass telescope and circular star-chart desk, crisp purposeful linework, carefully painted clean shapes, cobalt summer sky, warm white masonry and coral roof tiles, airy empty foreground, no written symbols.
